saw_lines: Venue owners join a booking tool only after they see a filled slot, then judge it on the first booking.
So the sale is decided in the ad itself, where an owner judges in seconds whether listing is worth the effort.
Your 2 Meta ads carry no proof number, so a venue owner has no figure to trust. Collect one real count, like venues listed, and lead the next ad with it.
ads_1: Venue owner ads on lost booking hours, tested against a price first version
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
